drums.tags: Drum break, funk style. Acoustic drum kit with a dry, tight room sound. The kick drum features a short decay and emphasizes the fundamental frequency around 60Hz. The snare drum is tuned high with a crisp, metallic ring and prominent ghost notes between the primary backbeats. Hi-hats are played slightly open, creating a consistent sizzle on eighth-note subdivisions. The pattern utilizes syncopated kick placements on the 'and' of beats 1 and 3, while the snare maintains a steady backbeat on 2 and 4 with occasional syncopated accents. 105 BPM, 4/4 time signature.

[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[four-bar drum break, dry acoustic kit]
[syncopated kick drum, ghost note snare accents]

[Main Section]
[steady hi-hat eighth notes with slight sizzle]
[snare backbeat on 2 and 4]
[kick drum syncopation on the off-beats]

[Outro]
[final snare hit with natural room decay]

bass.tags: Funk-rock instrumental. The arrangement features a clean, percussive electric guitar playing a syncopated 16th-note rhythmic pattern with frequent muted strums. A prominent electric bass guitar performs a slap-and-pop technique, locking tightly with the kick drum. The drum kit maintains a steady backbeat with a crisp snare and a tight, closed hi-hat. Occasional open hi-hat accents and subtle crash cymbal hits punctuate the transitions. The tempo is 105 BPM in 4/4 time. The mix is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing the rhythmic interplay between the bass and guitar.
